mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info ( nickname, email, pwd, translate_code, user_status, reg_dt, mod_dt ) VALUES ( #{nickname}, #{email}, #{pwd}, #{translateCode}, #{userStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_seq, u.email, u.nickname, u.pwd, u.use_yn, u.translate_code, u.user_status, u.reg_dt, u.mod_dt FROM user_info u WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT u.user_seq, u.email, u.nickname, u.pwd, u.use_yn, u.translate_code, u.user_status, u.reg_dt, u.mod_dt FROM user_info u WHERE u.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT r.role_seq, r.role_name, r.admin_yn FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role_info r ON ur.role_seq = r.role_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq}
SELECT r.role_seq, r.role_name FROM role_info r WHERE r.admin_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET user_status = #{userStatus}, use_yn = #{useYn}, translate_code = #{translateCode}, mod_dt = NOW() WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
UPDATE user_info SET pwd = #{pwd}, mod_dt = NOW() WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
